title: OpenRiC Vocabulary response
description: Validates a /vocabulary response. Advertises which RiC-O classes and predicates a conformant server emits, allowing clients to discover server capabilities before constructing queries.

classes.description: RiC-O classes this server emits (e.g. rico:Record, rico:Agent).

properties.description: RiC-O and OpenRiC properties this server emits (Core Discovery 3.2).

predicates.description: Former name of properties: deprecated since v0.54.0, accepted until v0.55.0.
